Step 1 — Determine whether document is an invoice
- Document contains explicit invoice indicators: title "Rechnung", "Belegnummer", "Datum", "Zwischensumme", "Endsumme", VAT mentions ("zzgl. MwSt.", "20,00 %"), line item and prices. No exclusion indicators ("Zahlungserinnerung"/"Mahnung") present. Conclusion: treat as invoice.

Step 2 — Identify sender VAT ID
- Bottom block lists "UID-Nr.: ATU67870324" associated with Huppenkothen (sender). Also text shows "Ihre UStIDNr ATU34760103" (customer), so Sender.VatId = "ATU67870324".

Step 3 — Locate invoice date
- Field "Datum 09.05.2023" near header. Invoice.Date = "09.05.2023".

Step 4 — Locate totals and VAT group
- "Zwischensumme EUR 24,00" → Net amount = 24,00.
- VAT line: "zzgl. MwSt. mit Steuercode 1 20,00 % von 24,00 4,80" → Vat.Rate = 20,00 (extract without % → numeric 20.00), Vat.Amount = 4,80.
- "Endsumme EUR 28,80" / payment terms showing "28,80 EUR" → GrandTotal.Amount = 28,80.

Step 5 — Apply formatting and rules
- No inference beyond visible values.
- Preserve decimal places as in source (two decimals).
- Convert comma decimals to numeric form for numeric fields.

Extracted candidate values to populate schema:
- GrandTotal.Amount = 28.80
- Invoice.Date = "09.05.2023"
- Sender.VatId = "ATU67870324"
- Vat.Rate = 20.00
- Net.Amount = 24.00
- Vat.Amount = 4.80
